params.body:
Two fixes to the evaluation that came out of the balanced gold-set run of 2026-10-10.

## Why

- **GLM 5.3 crashed the run.** Mistral sends a reasoning model's answer as a list of chunks: a `thinking` chunk, then `text` chunks. `callOpenAICompat` passed that list on as the answer, and `eval-models` threw `(text || "").replace is not a function` on it.
- **Haiku 4.5 was scored on fewer signals.** It needs up to 114 s for a batch of ten. Two of its batches were killed at the eval's 120 s limit (exit 143), so it was scored on 80 signals while every other model had 100.

## What changes

- **`messageText(content)` in `models.mjs`.** A string answer passes unchanged. For a list of chunks it keeps only the `text` chunks, never the thinking. Anything else becomes an empty answer instead of an object.
- **`eval-models`.** The batch timeout goes from 120 s to 300 s. Speed stays visible in the latency column.

Production phases keep their own timeouts.

## How it was tested

- New `test/message-text.test.mjs` covers a plain string, chunks with thinking, and unusable input.
- The provider, refusal and verify-tier tests still pass.
- `npm test`: everything passes except the six known `report-render` tests, which fail because the workbench has no `pdftoppm`.

## After merge

```bash
node packages/engine/eval-models.mjs classify mistral/zai-glm-5-3 --balanced --n 100 --seed 7
node packages/engine/eval-models.mjs classify --balanced --n 100 --seed 7      # Haiku 4.5 again, on all 100
node packages/engine/eval-models.mjs leaderboard classify --since 2026-10-10
```
params.title: Read a reasoning model's chunked answer as text, and give an eval batch five minutes
